seomatic-client-report v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill.
- Generates concise monthly SEO reports using real data from Search Console and other sources.
- Outlines outcome, completed work with results, AI search visibility, and next month’s priorities.
- Ensures every metric is sourced, dates are specified, and both positive and negative results are reported.
- Designed for transparency and clarity—no jargon or data guesswork.
